Our Work

Inside-Out Transformation Framework™

How organizational results take shape

Our approach examines the connections among five factors that influence how an organization works and what it produces.

01

Mindset

Beliefs, assumptions, and interpretations that influence how people see situations and make choices.

02

Behavior

Actions, habits, and interactions that shape how work happens day to day.

03

Systems

Structures, processes, incentives, and conditions that enable or constrain performance.

04

Strategy

Priorities, decisions, and plans that direct effort toward desired outcomes.

05

Results

The outcomes an organization produces, intended and unintended.
